description: Spoiler-free introductions for the wiki's character pages, approved by a human. Everything else on those pages is built from what has been shown on screen (wiki facts) and from the public parts of the character sheets.

brannoc.title: The Shield
brannoc.intro: A dwarf soldier of Fort Harrow carrying dispatches up the Lantern Road. Few words, a heavy shield, and a habit of standing in front of other people.

ilsevel.title: The Archivist
ilsevel.intro: An elf scholar of the Order of Lamplighters, sent to inspect the failing lanterns between thirty and forty-five. She writes everything down.

tamsin.title: The Card Player
tamsin.intro: A halfling with quick hands and quicker jokes, met playing cards in Brindle Cross under the name Tam Mossfoot. Has a nickname for everyone.

oriel.title: The Acolyte
oriel.intro: The young acolyte of the Shrine of the Open Hand in Brindle Cross, raised by Father Tobin Ashdown. Asks everyone their real name, and remembers it.
